title: Improving 2D and 3D Skin In Vitro Models Using Macromolecular Crowding
protocol: Seed 50,000 cells (primary fibroblasts or primary keratinocytes or co-culture of primary fibroblasts and keratinocytes) per well of a 24-well plate.
Incubate the seeded cells overnight at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator.
Discard old media and replace with fresh media containing macromolecular crowders and 100 µM ascorbic acid.
Grow cultures for 6 days at 37 °C in a 5% CO2 incubator, changing the media every 2 days.
Wash cell cultures twice with 1x PBS.
Fix cell cultures with either methanol or paraformaldehyde (depending on antibody specifications).
Aliquot 500 µl of cold methanol into each well for methanol fixation and incubate at -20 °C for 10 min.
Aspirate fixative and discard methanol waste after methanol fixation.
Air dry in a laminar fume hood after methanol fixation.
Aliquot 500 µl of 2% paraformaldehyde solution into each well for paraformaldehyde fixation and incubate at room temperature for 15 min.
Aspirate fixative and discard paraformaldehyde waste after paraformaldehyde fixation.
Wash with 1x PBS, performing three washes for 5 minutes per wash.
Aliquot 1 ml of 1x PBS into each well.
Aliquot 500 µl of 3% bovine serum albumin (diluted in 1x PBS) into each well.
Incubate at room temperature for 30 min.
Aspirate the blocking solution and discard.
Aliquot 200 µl of primary antibody (1:100 dilution in 10% goat serum) solution into each well.
Incubate for 90 min at room temperature.
For coverslips, aliquot 50 µl of primary antibody (1:100 dilution in 10% goat serum) solution onto a flat piece of Parafilm.
Place coverslip onto the Parafilm with the cell-side facing the solution.
Cover the entire cell-side without bubbles and incubate for 90 min at room temperature.
Aspirate primary antibody solution and discard.
Wash with 1x PBS, three times, 5 min per wash.
Aliquot 200 µl of secondary antibody (1:400 dilution in 10% goat serum) solution into each well.
Incubate for 30 min at room temperature, covering the plate with aluminum foil.
For coverslips, aliquot 50 µl of secondary antibody (1:400 dilution in 10% goat serum) solution onto a flat piece of Parafilm.
Place coverslip onto the Parafilm with the cell-side facing the solution.
Cover the entire cell-side without bubbles and incubate for 30 min at room temperature, covering the Parafilm with aluminum foil.
Aspirate secondary antibody solution and discard.
Wash with 1x PBS for three washes, 5 min per wash.
Aliquot 1 ml of 1x PBS into each well.
For imaging directly from plate: do not mount. Proceed to microscope.
For imaging of coverslips: Mount coverslips in mounting media onto a glass slide.
Dry overnight in a container covered with aluminum foil.
Proceed to microscope.
Acquire images using a confocal laser scanning microscope with a 40X/1.30 oil objective.
Wash cell layers twice with 1x PBS.
Aliquot 100 μl of lysis buffer into each well (6-well plate format).
Scrape the cell layer with a cell scraper and transfer solution into a microcentrifuge tube.
Centrifuge solution at 15,330 x g for 30 min at 4 °C.
Transfer the supernatant to another microcentrifuge tube and discard the pellet.
Mix 13 μl of each sample with 5 μl of sample buffer and 2 μl of reducing agent.
Heat samples at 95 °C for 10 min.
Centrifuge samples at 15,330 x g for 1 min to collect condensation water.
Load samples into a pre-cast PAGE gel.
Run the gel at 100 V for approximately 1 hr.
To transfer separated proteins to a nitrocellulose membrane: sandwich the gel and membrane between pieces of paper and sponges (of the same size).
Ensure there are no bubbles between the gel, membrane, papers and sponges.
Close the sandwich cassette and run the transfer at 70 V for 2 hr.
Incubate the membrane with 10 ml Ponceau S.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBS-Tween-20 for three times, 10 min per wash.
Block the membrane with 10 ml of 5% milk for 1 hr at room temperature.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBS-Tween-20 for three times, 10 min per wash.
Incubate the membrane with 10 ml primary antibody (mouse anti-collagen VII, LH 7.2, 1:1,000 dilution in 5% milk) for 90 min.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBS-Tween-20 for three times, 10 min per wash.
Incubate the membrane with 10 ml secondary antibody (goat anti-mouse-HRP, 1:2,000 dilution in 5% milk) for 30 min.
Wash the membrane with 0.1% PBS-Tween-20 for three times, 10 min per wash.
Transfer the membrane to a cassette and add 1 ml of ECL Detection Reagent.
Place a clear, thin plastic sheet over the membrane.
Place a light-sensitive film over the plastic sheet and close the cassette.
Remove the film from the cassette after 2-5 min.
Place the removed film into a developer.
Seed 50,000 cells (primary fibroblasts or primary keratinocytes or co-culture of primary fibroblasts and keratinocytes) per well of a 24-well plate.
Allow cells to adhere overnight in a 37 °C incubator at 5% CO₂.
Discard old media.
Replace with fresh media containing macromolecular crowders and 100 µM ascorbic acid.
The crowder cocktail consists of 37.5 mg/ml Ficoll 70 and 25 mg/ml Ficoll 400.
Maintain fibroblast cultures in DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS and 1% pen-strep.
Maintain keratinocytes in serum-free media, KSFM or CnT-57.
Incubate co-cultures for 6 days at 37 °C with 5% CO2, changing media every 2 days.
Wash cell layers twice in 1x PBS.
Add 250 µl of 0.5% sodium deoxycholate.
Incubate on ice for 10 min.
Aspirate cell lysate.
Repeat the washing and lysing steps thrice.
Wash cell-derived matrix twice in distilled H2O.
Keep cell-derived matrix in 1x PBS.
Store matrices at 4 °C for up to 1 week.
Prepare a Secondary Cell Suspension, for example seeding keratinocytes on top of f-mat.
Aspirate 1x PBS.
Seed 50,000 keratinocytes on the cell-derived matrix (f-mat).
Allow cells to adhere overnight in a 37 °C incubator at 5% CO2.
Fix samples following Protocol 2.2.
Perform image acquisition using a confocal laser scanning microscope with a 40X/1.30 oil objective.
Set the pinhole at 74 mm.
Use LP 505 for the interference reflection microscopy (IRM) channel and BP 575-615 IR for the fluorescence red channel as filters.
Use NT 80/20 for the IRM channel and HFT 405/488/561, NFT 565 plate for the fluorescence red channel as beam splitters.
Use DPSS 561-10 (wavelength 561 nm) at 1.1% power for the fluorescence red channel.
Use HeNe633 (wavelength 633 nm) at 5.0% power for the IRM channel.
Aliquot 10 ml of rat tail collagen type I to a cold beaker.
Add 1 ml of cold DMEM.
Add 0.5 ml of 1 M NaOH to neutralize the acidic collagen.
Add 0.5 ml of fibroblast suspension containing 1,200,000 fibroblasts.
Transfer the solution in a cold pipette to the cell-culture inserts within a 6-well plate.
Incubate the gel in a 37 °C incubator at 5% CO2 for 1 hour.
Submerge the gel in FM after it has solidified.
Discard old media after 24 hours and replace with fresh media containing macromolecular crowders.
Add 2 ml of fresh media to the interior and outside of the cell-culture insert.
Traypsinize keratinocytes using 0.125% trypsin/chelating agent for 5 minutes at 37 °C.
Neutralize trypsin with serum containing media after dislodging cells by gently tapping the flask sides.
Count cells and prepare a suspension of 300,000 keratinocytes per gel in 200 μl media.
Aspirate old media from cell-culture insert before adding keratinocyte suspension on top of the gel.
Incubate the gel with attached keratinocytes in a 37 °C incubator at 5% CO2 for 1 hour.
Submerge the gel with 2 ml KSFM or CnT-57 to the inside and 2 ml FM to the outside of the cell-culture insert after attachment.
Discard old media and replace with fresh media containing macromolecular crowders after another 24 hours.
Raise cultures to an air-liquid interface after 7 days of submerged culture.
Transfer the cell-culture insert to a deep-well plate for stratification media addition.
Add 10 ml stratification media to the outside of the cell-culture insert while keeping the interior dry.
Incubate cultures in a 37 °C incubator at 5% CO2 and change media every 3 days for the next 14 days.
Aspirate stratification media from the culture inserts.
Using tweezers, transfer the culture inserts onto a paper towel and dab away remaining media from the base of the insert.
Cut along the inner circumference of the culture insert using a scalpel.
Fix the organotypic skin co-culture (together with the PET membrane).
Transfer the gel construct to a cryomold for snap freezing.
Cover the interior of the cryomold with OCT compound.
Place the cryomold into liquid nitrogen for 10 seconds.
Remove the frozen cryomold from the liquid nitrogen and wrap in aluminum foil.
Store the frozen samples in a -80°C freezer.
Section frozen samples with a cryostat, with a section thickness of 7 μm.
Place a 'biopsy sponge pad' into the 'biopsy cassette'.
Transfer the gel construct onto the sponge pad for formalin fixation.
Place another sponge pad gently on top of the gel construct and close the cassette.
Fully submerge the cassette in 10% neutral buffered formalin for 48 hours at room temperature.
Remove the cassette and discard formalin waste after 48 hours.
Dehydrate the fixed sample with an ethanol series to embed into a wax block.
Gradually infiltrate the sample with wax to complete embedding.
Section the wax block with a microtome.
Incubate sections in 10% goat serum diluted in 1x PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash sections in 1x PBS to remove the goat serum.
Incubate sections with primary antibody (1:100 dilution in 10% goat serum) for 90 minutes at room temperature.
Wash sections in 1x PBS, three times, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Incubate sections with secondary antibody (1:400 dilution in 10% goat serum) for 30 minutes at room temperature, in a container covered with aluminum foil.
Wash sections in 1x PBS, three times, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Mount slides, with mounting media, onto coverglass.
Cover samples with aluminum foil and allow to dry overnight.

Dewax sections (and rehydrate) in descending percentages of ethanol to water: Xylene - 100% ethanol - 90% ethanol - 80% ethanol - 70% ethanol - water. Fully submerge samples in each solution for 3 minutes.
Incubate sections in 1% hydrogen peroxide for 30 minutes.
Wash sections in 1x PBS for 5 minutes.
Incubate sections in citrate solution (1 part citrate solution to 9 parts water) at 120 °C for 20 minutes.
Allow slides to cool overnight, at room temperature.
Wash sections in 1x PBS, three times, each wash lasting 5 minutes.
Incubate sections in 10% goat serum diluted in 1x PBS for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash sections in 1x PBS to remove the goat serum.
Incubate sections with primary antibody at a dilution of 1:100 in 10% goat serum for 90 minutes at room temperature.
Wash sections in 1x PBS three times, each for 10 minutes.
Incubate sections with HRP-labeled polymer undiluted for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Wash sections with 1x PBS three times, each for 10 minutes.
Combine 1 ml DAB Substrate and 1 drop of chromogen in a microcentrifuge tube.
Incubate the sections with this solution for 15 seconds to 5 minutes (until brown color appears).
To stop the reaction, wash the sections in running water.
Counterstain nuclei with hematoxylin for 5 minutes.
Rinse sections in running water.
Incubate sections in acid alcohol solution for 1 minute.
Rinse sections in running water.
Incubate sections in Scott's tap water solution for 2 minutes.
Rinse sections in running water.
Optional: Incubate sections in eosin for 1 minute and wash in running water.
Dehydrate sections through ascending percentages of ethanol to xylene (70% ethanol - 80% ethanol - 90% ethanol - 100% ethanol - xylene), ensuring samples are fully submerged for 3 minutes per stage.
Mount slides using mounting media to a coverglass.
Air dry overnight.
Image using a confocal microscope with a 40X/1.30 oil objective.
Fix samples in 2.5% glutaraldehyde for 72 hours.
Wash samples in 1x PBS three times, each for 10 minutes.
Cut samples into small pieces (1 mm³).
Post-fix samples in 1% osmium tetroxide, pH 7.4, for 1 hour at room temperature.
Wash samples in distilled water.
Dehydrate samples through an ascending ethanol series (25%, 50%, 75%, 95%, and 100%) and acetone for 20 minutes per step.
Infiltrate samples by soaking them in 1:1 acetone: araldite resin for 30 minutes at room temperature, followed by a 1:3 ratio for 1 hour, then overnight in a 1:6 ratio.
Soak samples in fresh araldite resin for 2 hours at room temperature, followed by 1 hour at 40 °C, 1 hour at 45 °C, and 1 hour at 50 °C.
Incubate samples at 60 °C for 24 hours to allow polymerization.
Section samples using a glass knife to obtain semi-thin sections with a thickness of 1 µm.
Stain section with methylene blue to observe histology.
Obtain ultra-thin sections of 70 nm and collect each section onto a copper grid.
Stain sections with 5% uranyl acetate solution for 15 minutes followed by 3% lead citrate solution for 10 minutes.
Acquire images with a transmission electron microscope (100 kV) at a magnification of 30,000X.
